final: WITH source_sums AS (SELECT source, SUM(amount) AS source_sum FROM income GROUP BY source), total AS (SELECT SUM(source_sum) AS total_sum FROM source_sums), paired AS (SELECT s.source_sum, 1.0 * s.source_sum / t.total_sum AS share FROM source_sums AS s CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_sum IS NOT NULL), source_average AS (SELECT AVG(source_sum) AS avg_source_sum FROM paired) SELECT AVG(p.source_sum), AVG(p.share), AVG(p.source_sum - a.avg_source_sum) FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN source_average AS a WHERE a.avg_source_sum IS NOT NULL AND p.source_sum > a.avg_source_sum
